settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.help: The language of the web interface. Automatic follows your browser's language, falling back to English.
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Changes apply to the next poll; no restart needed.
settings.glucose.title: Glucose and timing
settings.unit.label: Unit
settings.rangeLow.label: Target low (mg/dL)
settings.rangeHigh.label: Target high (mg/dL)
settings.veryLow.label: Very low below (mg/dL)
settings.veryLow.help: Level-2 hypoglycemia threshold (consensus: 54). Used by the Overview analytics.
settings.veryHigh.label: Very high above (mg/dL)
settings.preMin.label: Minutes before start
settings.postMin.label: Minutes after end
settings.postMin.help: Cooldown glucose shown on the chart photo only; the description text is always activity-only and does not wait for this.
settings.pollMin.label: Check Strava every (minutes)
settings.postBuffer.label: Reprocess once more after (minutes)
settings.postBuffer.help: Catches glucose readings that had not arrived yet the first time, for both the description text and (with the chart photo on) its first upload, which waits for this so it is not attached with an incomplete curve. 0 turns both off.
settings.dexcom.title: Dexcom Share
settings.dexcom.intro: Turn on Dexcom Share in the Dexcom app first. The account is the one that owns the sensor.
settings.dexcom.region.label: Region
settings.dexcom.username.label: Username, email or phone
settings.dexcom.password.label: Password
settings.secret.password.set: A password is stored. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
settings.secret.token.set: A token is stored. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
settings.secret.secret.set: A secret is stored. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
settings.chart.title: Chart photo
settings.chart.intro: Optionally attach the glucose chart to the Strava activity as a photo. The preview below updates as you change the options, using your latest activity (or sample data), before anything is saved.
settings.chartImage.label: Attach the chart to each activity
settings.chartImage.help: Once per activity. Experimental: glucava cannot remove photos again, and a first photo can replace the map as the activity's cover.
settings.chartTheme.label: Theme
settings.chartSize.label: Size
settings.chartSize.help: Strava shows the photo as a square. Large is 1620 px, otherwise 1080 px.
settings.chartPre.label: Glucose before the activity (minutes)
settings.chartPre.help: How far back the chart starts. Only the chart uses this; the numbers use the window under Glucose and timing.
settings.chartLine.label: Line thickness (1 to 4)
settings.hrRead.label: Read heart rate from Strava
settings.hrRead.help: Fetched when an activity is processed (one extra page load) and kept, for the numbers on the activity page and in emails, and for the chart.
settings.panels.label: Panels
settings.panels.help: Toggle which layers are drawn, and reorder them: where activity and target-range shading overlap, the one listed lower wins.
settings.panel.elevation: Show elevation profile (background; fetched from Strava when on)
settings.chartAvgLine.label: Average line
settings.chartAvgLine.help: A dashed line at the average glucose value.
settings.chartRangeLines.label: Low/high lines
settings.chartRangeLines.help: Dashed lines at the target range low and high.
settings.chartMinMax.label: Min/max markers
settings.chartMinMax.help: Marker dots at the curve's lowest and highest points.
settings.chartHideStats.label: Hide the TIR number and stats bar
settings.chartHideStats.help: Turns off the big time-in-range number and the below/in-range/above bar at the bottom.
settings.desc.title: Description text
settings.desc.intro: What gets appended to the Strava activity description. Pick a preset to start from, or write your own (Go text/template syntax: {{.TIR}}, {{.TIRWindow}}, {{.TIRBar}}, {{.TIRWindowBar}}, {{.Min}}, {{.Max}}, {{.Avg}}, {{.StdDev}}, {{.CV}}, {{.GMI}}, {{.VeryLow}}, {{.VeryHigh}}, {{.Unit}}, {{.Distance}}, {{.Elevation}}, {{.Pace}}, {{.Sparkline}}; {{if .Sparkline}}...{{end}} to only show a line when it's there). {{.TIR}} is the activity window; {{.TIRWindow}} is the wider pre/post window the chart draws from below, so the two can differ — add both if you want to show that. {{.Pace}} is a single field that's already the right unit for the activity's sport (pace for a run/hike/walk/swim, speed for a ride), empty when there's no meaningful distance metric for the sport. The preview below updates as you type, using your latest activity or sample data.
settings.descPreset.label: Preset
settings.descPreset.help: Selecting one replaces the template below; keep editing afterwards to customize it further.
settings.descTemplate.label: Template
settings.descPreview.label: Preview
settings.notify.title: Notifications
settings.notify.intro: Sent when something fails, for example an expired Strava session or missing glucose data.
settings.gapAlertHours.label: Alert when no glucose reading arrives for (hours)
settings.gapAlertHours.help: Catches a stopped sensor share or a broken Dexcom login. 0 turns it off.
settings.ntfyURL.label: ntfy topic URL
settings.ntfyURL.help: For example https://ntfy.sh/my-topic. Leave empty to turn off.
settings.ntfyToken.label: ntfy access token
settings.webhookURL.label: Webhook URL
settings.webhookURL.help: Receives each event as JSON. Leave empty to turn off.
settings.webhookSecret.label: Webhook signing secret
settings.email.title: Email
settings.email.intro: Send notifications by email through your own SMTP server. Leave the recipient empty to turn email off.
settings.emailTo.label: Send to
settings.smtpHost.label: SMTP host
settings.smtpPort.label: Port
settings.smtpUsername.label: Username
settings.smtpPassword.label: Password
settings.smtpSender.label: From address
settings.smtpSenderName.label: From name
settings.smtpTLS.label: Require TLS
settings.smtpTLS.help: Tick for port 465. Otherwise StartTLS is used when the server offers it.
settings.mailAlerts.label: Failure alerts
settings.mailAlerts.help: Expired session, failed update, missing glucose data, canary failures.
settings.mailActivity.label: Summary after each activity
settings.mailActivity.help: One mail per processed activity with its glucose numbers.
settings.mailWeekly.label: Weekly summary
settings.mailWeekly.help: Every Monday morning: last week's activities and glucose numbers, or a short note if there were none.
settings.mailHealth.label: Monthly health report
settings.mailHealth.help: On the 1st, 08:00: activities annotated or failed, glucose data coverage, alerts of the month. Doubles as a sign that glucava is still running.
settings.publicURL.label: Public URL of this web UI
settings.publicURL.help: Used for links in emails, for example https://glucava.example.com. Leave empty for no links.
settings.import.title: Import glucose readings
settings.import.intro: Backfill readings from an export file, e.g. switching from another app or restoring a period the live source no longer serves. This adds to what is already stored; nothing existing is touched.
settings.import.format.label: Format
settings.import.source.label: Label (optional)
settings.import.source.help: Distinguishes these readings from the live source; defaults to the format name.
settings.import.file.label: Export file
settings.account.title: Account
settings.account.intro: Change the email or the password you sign in to this page with. Both need your current password, and every other browser is signed out. Leave a field empty to keep it.
settings.account.current.label: Current password
settings.account.email.label: New email
settings.account.new.label: New password
settings.account.confirm.label: Repeat the new password
settings.data.title: Your data
settings.data.intro: Glucose readings, activities and events are stored on this server only. Old readings and events are deleted after the number of days below; 0 keeps them forever.
settings.retentionDays.label: Keep readings and events for (days)
settings.purge.label: Delete all data
settings.purge.help: Removes every reading, activity and event. Settings, credentials and tokens stay. Type DELETE to enable the button.
dash.title: Activities
dash.sub: Strava activities and the glucose data added to them.
dash.tile.annotated.label: Annotated, 14 days
dash.tile.tir.label: Average time in range
dash.tile.failed.label: Failed
dash.tile.session.label: Strava session
dash.empty.title: No activities yet
dash.empty.hint: New Strava activities appear here once polling finds them. Use “Check Strava now” to look right away.
dash.empty.nosession: glucava needs your Strava session before it can find activities.
activity.head.delete.title: Delete this activity?
activity.head.delete.body: Removes glucava's record of this activity. This does not touch Strava, other than trying to restore the original description first if one was saved.
activity.processing.generic: Starting the browser and writing to Strava usually takes under a minute; this page updates by itself.
strava.title: Strava session
strava.sub: glucava logs in to Strava with your own browser cookies. It does not use the Strava API.
strava.status.title: Session status
strava.cookies.col.name: Cookie
strava.missing: The session cookie (_strava4_session) is missing, so Strava will probably reject these cookies.
strava.login.title: Sign in automatically (experimental)
strava.login.warning: Unverified against the real Strava login form. It gives up at the first CAPTCHA, verification code or wrong-password message and never guesses past one; nothing is stored unless it reaches your dashboard. If it fails, use cookie import below instead. Strava may notice a new sign-in and email you about it, same as any other browser login.
strava.login.email.label: Strava email
strava.login.password.label: Strava password
strava.login.password.help: Never stored; only the resulting session cookies are, exactly like cookie import.
strava.import.title: Import cookies
strava.import.intro: Log in to strava.com in your browser, export the cookies for strava.com, and paste them here. Three formats work:
strava.import.format.json: a JSON export from a cookie extension (Cookie-Editor and similar)
strava.import.format.header: a Cookie header copied from the browser's network tab
strava.import.label: Cookies
strava.import.help: Stored encrypted. Only the cookie names are ever shown again.
strava.process.title: Process a specific activity
strava.process.intro: Write the glucose description onto an activity that was never auto-detected, for example one from before glucava was running, or older than the polling window. It is looked up in your Strava training log if it isn't already known here.
strava.process.label: Strava activity id
strava.process.help: The number at the end of the activity's URL on strava.com.
strava.good.title: Good to know
strava.good.tos: Automating the Strava website goes against Strava's terms of service. glucava uses one browser, one account and a few page loads per activity. Use it at your own risk.
strava.good.cookies: Treat these cookies like a password: anyone who has them is logged in as you. Log out of the browser session you exported from only if you want to invalidate them.
strava.good.expiry: When Strava ends the session, you get a notification and need to import fresh cookies.
tokens.title: Triggers
tokens.sub: Tell glucava about a new activity right away instead of waiting for the next poll.
tokens.new.title: New token
tokens.name.label: Name
tokens.name.help: For example the device it is for.
tokens.list.title: Trigger tokens
tokens.col.name: Name
tokens.reveal.created: Token “{name}” created. Copy it now; it is not shown again.
tokens.reveal.hint: A working call answers 202, and “Last used” in the list below changes.
tokens.tasker.title: Android (Tasker)
tokens.tasker.intro: A ready-to-import profile: Strava notification → check now, unfiltered (see below for why).
tokens.tasker.qr: QR code to download the Tasker profile
tokens.other.title: Other platforms
tokens.other.intro: Scan to open this page on the phone you'll set the trigger up on — the instructions below fill in this real token instead of a placeholder.
tokens.other.qr: QR code to open the Triggers page
tokens.how.title: How to call it
tokens.how.intro: Send a POST request with the token. The call only asks glucava to check Strava now; it carries no other data. “Last used” in the list above shows whether your phone's call arrived.
tokens.how.android.title: Android (Tasker)
tokens.how.android.1: Task: Net → HTTP Request. Method POST, URL and header as above, empty body, timeout 30. Run it once by hand and check “Last used”.
tokens.how.android.2: Profile: Event → UI → Notification, owner application Strava, no filter yet. Link it to the task.
tokens.how.android.3: After Strava's next “activity saved” notification, look at Tasker's run log. If the profile also fires for kudos or comments, add a title or text filter with the wording you see there.
tokens.how.android.4: Tasker needs notification access and unrestricted battery use.
tokens.how.android.other: HTTP Shortcuts and MacroDroid work the same way: trigger on a Strava notification, then send the request.
tokens.how.iphone.title: iPhone (Shortcuts)
tokens.how.iphone.body: Personal automation → Workout → Ends (or App → Strava → Is Closed), set to Run Immediately. Actions: Wait 30 seconds, then Get Contents of URL with method POST and the header above. iOS cannot react to another app's notification. This has not been tested yet.
tokens.how.fallback: Without any trigger, polling still picks up new activities on the interval from Settings.
logs.title: Logs
logs.sub: Recent structured log entries from this process, newest first.
push.title: Push notifications
push.intro: Get alerts and summaries as a notification on this phone or computer, without an app. Messages are sent through your browser's push service (Google, Mozilla or Apple) and contain the notification text only.
push.notice.insecure: Push needs a secure connection. Open glucava over HTTPS (or on localhost) to turn it on.
push.notice.ios: On iPhone and iPad, add glucava to the Home Screen first (Share, then Add to Home Screen), open it from there, and turn push on in that window. Needs iOS 16.4 or newer.
push.notice.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
push.notice.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then reload this page.
push.notice.nokey: The push key could not be created. Check the server log.
push.js.denied: Notifications were not allowed. Allow them for this site in the browser settings.
push.alerts.label: Failure alerts
push.alerts.help: Expired session, failed update, missing glucose data, canary failures.
push.summaries.label: Summaries
push.summaries.help: After each processed activity, the weekly summary and the monthly health report.
push.saved: Saved with Save settings below. Push messages never contain charts or more than a few lines of text.
push.toast.bad_sub: The browser sent an unreadable subscription.
push.toast.subscribed: This device will now get push notifications.
push.toast.off: Push notifications are off on this device.

validate.unit: Unit must be mg/dL or mmol/L.
validate.range_low: Target low must be between 40 and 200 mg/dL.
validate.range_high: Target high must be above the low value and at most 400 mg/dL.
validate.thresholds: Very low must be between 20 and the target low, and very high between the target high and 600 mg/dL.
validate.minutes: Minutes before and after must be between 0 and 240.
validate.chart_theme: Chart theme must be light or dark.
validate.chart_size: Chart size must be standard or large.
validate.chart_lead: Chart lead-in must be between 0 and 240 minutes.
validate.chart_line: Chart line thickness must be between 1 and 4.
validate.poll: The polling interval must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
validate.post_buffer: The delayed reprocess buffer must be between 0 and 180 minutes.
validate.retention: Retention must be between 0 and 3650 days.
validate.ntfy_url: The ntfy URL must start with http:// or https://.
validate.webhook_url: The webhook URL must start with http:// or https://.
validate.email_to: The notification email address is not valid.
validate.smtp_port: The SMTP port must be between 1 and 65535.
validate.smtp_sender: The SMTP sender address is not valid.
validate.gap_alert: The glucose gap alert must be between 0 and 168 hours.
validate.public_url: The public URL must start with http:// or https://.
validate.smtp_needs: SMTP needs a port and a sender address.
validate.panel_order: Chart panel order must only list activity, band, dots, hr.
validate.language: Language must be auto or one of the installed languages.
validate.artifact_mode: Suspected artifacts must be handled as flagged or exclude.
validate.overview_range: The default Overview range must be one of {ranges}.
validate.overview_layout: The Overview layout is not valid JSON: {error}
